title: Replying to @Hrnndz I absolutley ADORE Jeanna’s Lovett and here’s why...
transcript: Alright so in my last video I mentioned that I like Jeanna DeWaal’s Lovett better than I liked Annaleigh Ashford’s and this person is asking for more information so these are my full thoughts on why I love Jeanna’s Lovett so much and how it compares to Annaleigh’s. I think I would say overall that Jeanna’s Lovett is more grounded than Annaleigh’s. Her Lovett actually feels like a real person, whereas Annaleigh’s feels like more of a character because of how broadly she plays everything. So while if you're looking for more humor in your Lovett you will probably like Annaleigh’s, I personally liked Jeanna’s more grounded approach. And that's not to say that Jeanna’s Lovett isn't funny, she still does all the same antics and is in the same mold as Annaleigh, she just does it all a little bit more subdued and I think that makes all the difference. One of the other things I loved about Jeanna’s Lovett is that it was the first time I had ever really seen a Lovett that feels genuinely in love with Sweeney Todd. Annaleigh plays Love It as very horny, and you definitely get a lust, but with Jeanna’s Lovett it feels like she's genuinely down bad for this man. And the last thing I'll say is while I myself am not a stickler for accents, I know many people are and Annaleigh’s accent is all over the map whereas Jeanna’s accent felt far more consistent probably because she's actually British.
